fieldValues.title: ext:recommended-relations
fieldValues.content: **Retired as of RFC-005.** The canonical SRS relation vocabulary (`contains`, `depends-on`, `supersedes`, `refines`, `derived-from`, `evidences`, `precedes`) is installed as `RelationTypeDefinition` records in the `com.semanticops.srs` package, and every `Relation.relationType` must resolve to one before the Relation is accepted. See the Conformance concept and Relation type definition.
